profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa that trades under the ticker SHOP and files with the SEC under CIK 0001594805. On its own website, the company describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses, offering a free trial and tools to manage every part of a business rather than ecommerce software alone.

The site frames AI as central to how merchants build and grow. Shopify says businesses can get discovered across AI channels, with shoppers checking out directly in a chat, a capability the company attributes to Agentic Storefronts. No lawsuits, additional products, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
